name: How long does door alignment repair usually take?

mainEntity.name: How long does door alignment repair usually take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for door alignment repair can vary based on the severity and cause of the problem. Simple adjustments, like tightening hinges or adjusting a strike plate, might take as little as an hour. More complex issues involving warped frames or underlying structural problems could require several hours or even a return visit. To help us estimate timing more accurately, you can provide photos or a detailed description of the issue when you first reach out.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; simple adjustments can be an hour, while complex issues may take several hours or require a return visit.
